## 🧪 Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin / BDD Format)
*Describe the expected behavior of the system. Feel free to duplicate this block if you have multiple scenarios.*

**Scenario:** [Brief title of the scenario]
- **GIVEN** [the initial context, setup, or state of the system]
- **WHEN** [the specific action is taken or event occurs]
- **THEN** [the expected outcome, reaction, or system change]
- **AND** [any additional conditions or results]

## ✅ Definition of Done (DoD)
*This task is considered 'Done' and ready for review/deployment only when the following criteria are met:*

### Development & Quality
- [ ] Code is thoroughly tested locally and functions as expected.
- [ ] Code has been reviewed and approved by at least one peer engineer.
- [ ] All automated CI/CD pipeline checks pass successfully (build, lint, tests).

### Infrastructure & Deployment
- [ ] Changes are successfully synced/deployed to the Dev environment.
- [ ] All necessary environment variables, config maps, or secrets are configured.

### Documentation & Handoff
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated (Confluence, README, or API docs).
- [ ] Any related or blocking sub-issues have been updated or closed.
